title: Elucidation of the genetic and epigenetic landscape alterations in RNA binding proteins in glioblastoma
central_claims: Genetic and epigenetic alterations characterize the glioblastoma RNA-binding-protein landscape.
The HERC5/NOL3/SUCLG1/AFF3 expression signature predicts glioblastoma survival.
Selected signature proteins support glioma stem-cell neurosphere formation.

source_manifest.title: Elucidation of the genetic and epigenetic landscape alterations in RNA binding proteins in glioblastoma
source_manifest.finding: RBP landscape analysis and four-gene prognostic signature; HERC5 knockdown impaired glioma stem-cell neurospheres.

source_manifest.title: HERC5/ISG15 Enhances Glioblastoma Stemness and Tumor Progression by mediating SERBP1protein stability
source_manifest.finding: Independent Henan team links HERC5 to glioblastoma stemness through ISG15/SERBP1, with sphere assays and xenografts; cites original study.

source_manifest.title: Identification of a 6-RBP gene signature for a comprehensive analysis of glioma and ischemic stroke: Cognitive impairment and aging-related hypoxic stress
source_manifest.finding: Lin and colleagues report concordant copy-number/expression associations while constructing a different six-gene model. They note that clinical evaluation of earlier RBP markers remains incomplete.

answers.rationale: The four-gene survival signature remains unverified independently. Later studies support HERC5 biology and broad copy-number associations, rather than the complete prognostic contribution.
No independent reconstruction of the four-gene survival model was found. The six-gene study changes the predictor set and shares TCGA data.
The HERC5 xenografts extend one functional result; they do not test the complete signature on a stricter clinical cohort.
No retrieved authoritative assessment adjudicates the original signature; the later six-gene paper describes incomplete clinical evaluation of earlier RBP markers.
Prospective prognosis and clinical utility were not established by follow-up that explicitly tests those limitations.
The cited HERC5 result is extended mechanistically to ISG15/SERBP1.

evidence.explanation: The cited HERC5 result is extended mechanistically to ISG15/SERBP1.

answers.rationale: Two independent teams discuss related biology, but substantive reuse of the same specific contribution by both is not established.
The later six-gene model does not apply the original four-gene score. HERC5 follow-up does not demonstrate reuse of the landscape-analysis method.
The retrieved studies do not supply a review explicitly attributing a new research direction to this paper.
No actual benchmark of the four-gene score against alternative prognostic models was located.
Mechanistic follow-up is documented, but a concrete benefit from applying the original predictive model or landscape resource was not demonstrated.
HERC5 was studied further in glioblastoma; transfer of the original signature to another disease or clinical setting remains unverified.
HERC5 follow-up identifies SERBP1 stabilization, beyond the original sphere phenotype.

evidence.explanation: HERC5 follow-up identifies SERBP1 stabilization, beyond the original sphere phenotype.

answers.rationale: No clinical workflow using the four-gene prognosis score was documented in the retrieved evidence.
No independent head-to-head evaluation verifies the original signature’s claimed prognostic advantage.
HERC5 follow-up appeared in 2025, over eight years later.

evidence.explanation: HERC5 follow-up appeared in 2025, over eight years later.

answers.rationale: The 2025 study supports HERC5 only. It does not assess the central four-gene prognosis result.
The 2022 copy-number agreement and 2025 mechanism concern different portions of the paper; sustained substantive follow-up of the specific signature is not established.
Searches found contextual discussion, but no accessible independent synthesis adopting the full signature as validated.
Later alternative RBP models were found, but none establishes that this original model remains useful alongside them.

search_gaps: Full 2025 follow-up was paywalled; abstract, author affiliations and references were read. No independently tested four-gene prognostic score, clinical deployment, or direct contradictory replication was located. Nearby RBP signatures are not treated as reuse of this exact signature.

Broader author and RBP-method searches found a six-gene follow-up and contextual reviews; inaccessible review pages were not counted as read supporting evidence. Copy-number agreement uses overlapping public data and is not independent validation of the original four-gene model.
research.summary: Independent follow-up supports the HERC5 stemness component and develops its mechanism. The complete prognostic signature and proposed clinical utility remain unverified in the retrieved evidence.
